name: Quote generation - missing quantity then provided
description: Customer asks for a quote without specifying quantity. AI should ask for quantity first, then customer provides it in a second message.

messages.text: Hi, my name is Test Customer. Can I get a quote for white melamine 16mm please

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Two-message scenario. AI should prompt for quantity on first message, then generate_quote on the second. 9s delay between messages gives AI time to respond.
